questions.question_english: Due to strict financial regulations, the Principal of a government school cannot provide financial bonuses to teachers who organized a highly successful state-level science exhibition. How can the Principal best reward them using non-monetary means?
options_english: Commend them in service records and publicly felicitate them in the school assembly.
Offer them an unofficial discretionary financial cut directly from the exhibition project budget.
Grant them 10 additional days of casual leave beyond their statutory annual entitlement limit.
Exempt them completely from routine classroom teaching duties for the remainder of the academic term.
questions.explanation_english: When statutory budget constraints prohibit monetary bonuses, school administrators should utilize non-monetary recognition mechanisms. questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। जब वैधानिक बजट प्रतिबंध मौद्रिक बोनस को रोकते हैं, तो स्कूल प्रशासन को गैर-मौद्रिक मान्यता तंत्र का उपयोग करना चाहिए। सेवा रिकॉर्ड में प्रशंसा को आधिकारिक रूप से दस्तावेजित करना और स्कूल सभाओं के दौरान सार्वजनिक रूप से सम्मानित करना असाधारण शिक्षक समर्पण को मान्यता देता है, उच्च-क्रम के पेशेवर सम्मान की आवश्यकताओं को संतुष्ट करता है, और सरकारी प्रशासनिक ढांचों के साथ पूरी तरह से मेल खाता है बिना वित्तीय या सेवा नियमों का उल्लंघन किए।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Commend them in service records and publicly felicitate them in the school assembly.

questions.question_hindi:

        फल-फूल सकती है जब सभी प्रकार के बाह्य पुरस्कार पूरी तरह से

questions.source: AI-generated from supplied reference material; Rewards and Employee Welfare

questions.question_english: What does the “Overjustification Effect” suggest regarding the relationship between intrinsic and extrinsic rewards?
options_english: External rewards for an already intrinsically rewarding activity can decrease overall motivation.
Providing high extrinsic rewards will always proportionally increase intrinsic motivation across all tasks.
Extrinsic rewards are completely ineffective and counterproductive in modern educational administrative settings.
Intrinsic motivation can only exist and flourish if all forms of extrinsic rewards are entirely removed.
questions.explanation_english: The Overjustification Effect is a psychological phenomenon where introducing external tangible rewards for an activity that an individual already finds inherently interesting can paradoxically undermine intrinsic motivation. When individuals attribute their performance to external rewards rather than internal passion, their self-determination decreases, causing baseline intrinsic motivation to decline once external incentives are removed or reduced.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (a) है। Overjustification Effect एक मनोवैज्ञानिक घटना है जहाँ किसी गतिविधि के लिए बाह्य ठोस पुरस्कारों को पेश करने से, जिसे व्यक्ति पहले से ही स्वाभाविक रूप से दिलचस्प मानता है, आंतरिक प्रेरणा को उलटकर कमजोर किया जा सकता है। जब व्यक्ति अपने प्रदर्शन को बाह्य पुरस्कारों के बजाय आंतरिक जुनून से जोड़ते हैं, तो उनकी आत्म-निर्धारण क्षमता कम हो जाती है, जिससे बाह्य प्रोत्साहनों को हटाने या कम करने पर आधारभूत आंतरिक प्रेरणा में गिरावट आती है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) External rewards for an already intrinsically rewarding activity can decrease overall motivation.

Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Overjustification Effect is a psychological phenomenon where introducing external tangible rewards for an activity that an individual already finds inherently interesting can paradoxically undermine intrinsic motivation.
